cc:Work.dc:title: Round-trip latency across message sizes
cc:Work.dc:description: Six measured series from one harness, posture and pacing: the five series of the native fixed 100 Hz campaign plus ROS 2 Jazzy over rmw_cerulion, three nodes in three processes with full process isolation. Commanded 100 Hz; the footnote carries the offered-rate caveat for the stock and composed ROS 2 lanes.

g.text: Same-host comparison on an x86-64 Linux desktop (24-core Intel Core Ultra 9 285K)

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: STOCK · recorder ON · fixed 100 Hz · k=5

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: Commanded 100 Hz, achieved on every cell by the Cerulion and zenoh lanes; the two ROS 2 lanes record the rate offered, not what came

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: back: at 16 MiB a stock ROS 2 round trip outlasts the 10 ms pacing interval, so requests overlap in flight. Native Cerulion includes

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: always-on recording; the ROS 2 and zenoh runs do not. Payload fill excluded.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: rmw_cerulion is ROS 2 Jazzy over Cerulion's transport, measured in the same harness, posture and pacing as the other lines: three

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: nodes in three processes with full process isolation. Non-POD, variable-length ROS messages work too, with no code to rewrite.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: ROS 2 composed + intra-process runs every node in one process: lower latency by giving up crash isolation, and its timed path

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: bypasses the middleware, so outside tools do not see the traffic being measured.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: Five sessions per point. p50: median of the five session medians; p99: 10,000 pooled samples.
